title: the_call_of_cthulhu
author: H. P. Lovecraft
summary: A man investigating his late grand-uncle's papers pieces together evidence of a global cult worshiping the ancient, cosmic entity Cthulhu, culminating in a sailor's account of encountering the risen monster in the sunken city of R'lyeh, and comes to fear he knows too much to survive.

issues.description: A Transcriber's Note about the Weird Tales, February 1928 source and U.S. copyright renewal is embedded at the story's start.
Title heading and byline appear at the start of the story text (flagged as start-contamination).
